gizmo.title: Mmega mgbakọ
gizmo.description: Usoro nsogbu mgbakọ dị mkpụmkpụ e mepụtara nwere nzaghachi ozugbo. Họrọ arụmọrụ na oke ọnụọgụ; egwuregwu ọ bụla bụ ọhụrụ.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: Aha mmega a, e gosiri n'isi ya.

configure.title: Arụmọrụ
configure.description: Ụdị nsogbu ndị a na-ajụ. Ndị mmụta nwere ike ịgbanyụ nke ọ bụla n'ime ha tupu ha amalite.

configure.title: Ọnụọgụ kacha nta
configure.description: Ọnụọgụ kacha nta e ji na nsogbu. Ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, 0 ma ọ bụ karịa.

configure.title: Ọnụọgụ kacha ibu
configure.description: Ọnụọgụ kacha ibu e ji na nsogbu. Azịza nkewa na ndị nkewa na-anọkwa n'oke a.

configure.title: Ọnụọgụ nsogbu
configure.description: Ole nsogbu dị n'otu egwuregwu (1 ruo 100).

advanced.title: Oke oge
advanced.description: Sekọnd ekwere maka egwuregwu dum. 0 pụtara enweghị oge nleba, nke bụ ndabara: mmega nwere oge na-emebi ndị mmụta chọrọ oge karịa. Mgbe etọrọ ya, ndị mmụta ka nwere ike ịgbanyụ oge nleba maka onwe ha.

advanced.title: Agba ntụpọ
advanced.description: Agba akara isi na bọtịnụ. Hapụ ya efu ka o soro isiokwu.
